comments.text: Take a bus until the final stop(terminal), escape the taxi drivers and go past the gate. If you walk a bit there is a bunch of great spots. Keep in mind, that the karamyk border crossing to kyrgyzstan is closed for foreigners (07.2025)

comments.text: Walked a bit after the roundabout past the shared taxis. Might take a while to find a free ride as there's many taxis and people asking for money but you will get one eventually. Didn't take me too long to find one to Ayni. Many drive to Khujand.

Took the bus number 3 to the final destination. Once you are out, many taxi drivers will appear so go straight. Many people on the side due to that but many cars and truck coming after the roundabout. The second truck stopped and took me until the big tunnel but with with a bit more luck you could get another one not driving to one of the mines in the surroundings
